# Product context

**Biograph** (packaged as the Frappe app `healthcare`; this fork is tracked in Build as **fossibleHIS**) is an open-source Hospital Information System (HIS). It is a fork of Marley Health, with additional features. It adds the health domain to **ERPNext** and runs on the **Frappe** framework. Much of its data model follows **HL7 FHIR**.

## Who uses it
- **Healthcare practitioners, clinics and hospitals**: they work in the Frappe desk at `/desk/healthcare`. The workspaces are Healthcare, Outpatient, Inpatient, Diagnostics, Rehabilitation, Insurance and Setup.
- **Patients**: they use the Vue-based **Patient Portal** at `/patient-portal` (role `Patient`) and web forms (appointments, lab tests, prescriptions, personal details, registration).

## Main feature areas
- Patient management, including duplicate-patient detection.
- Outpatient work: Patient Appointment (slot-based and block-time booking), Patient Encounter, Fee Validity and Practitioner Schedule.
- Inpatient work: Inpatient Record, medication orders and entries, and service-unit occupancy billing.
- Clinical Procedures, Lab Tests, Sample Collection, Observations and Diagnostic Reports.
- Rehabilitation and physiotherapy: Therapy Plans, Therapy Sessions and Exercises.
- Medical coding and terminology: Code System, Code Value, Code Value Set and the Codification Table, with work toward FHIR terminology parity.
- Insurance: Insurance Payor and Insurance Claim.
- Billing through ERPNext: Sales Invoice is overridden and Payment Entry hooks are added.
- Regional: India ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) integration in `healthcare/regional/india/abdm`.

Pharmacy, purchasing, HR, accounts and assets come from ERPNext itself.
